declaration.title: Accessibility statement
declaration.description: How this website conforms to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.2 AA, RGAA), known inaccessible content, contact and how to seek redress.
declaration.pending: Provisional version: the final statement will be published after the site audit.
declaration.intro: I am committed to making this website accessible to everyone, whatever their hardware, software and abilities. This statement applies to the website {site}.

status.title: Compliance status
status.text: This website is {status} with the RGAA: it has not yet been audited. Without valid audit results, the RGAA requires it to be declared non-compliant, so no compliance rate is published.

standard.title: Target standard
standard.text: The website aims for level AA of WCAG 2.2 (Web Content Accessibility Guidelines) and for the RGAA (the French general accessibility improvement framework), version 4.1.2 or the version in force on the date of the audit.

technologies.title: Technologies used
technologies.text: The website is built with HTML5, CSS and JavaScript; WAI-ARIA supplements the semantics of interactive components.

tests.title: Test environment
tests.text: During development, every page is checked automatically with axe-core (WCAG 2.2 level A and AA criteria) in the Chromium browser, at seven screen widths from 390 to 3,440 pixels, in the light and dark themes and with enhanced contrast, in French and in English. Manual tests, with the keyboard and with screen readers, will be carried out during the audit.

issues.title: Inaccessible content
issues.none: No accessibility issue has been identified so far. This list will be drawn up by the audit.
items: The CV in PDF format (“CV PDF” menu) is untagged: it has no structure (headings, lists), no declared language and no document title, which makes it hard to read with a screen reader. {language} Alternative: the content of the CV is presented on the page itself, and I can send it in another form on request.

cvLanguage.frenchOnly: It is written in French, including from the English version of the site.
cvLanguage.both: It is available in French and in English, and both versions are in this state.

contact.title: Feedback and contact
contact.text: If you cannot access some content or a feature of this website, write to me: I will point you to an accessible alternative or send you the content in another format.
contact.subject: Website accessibility

remedies.title: How to seek redress
remedies.text: If you have reported an accessibility issue that prevents you from accessing some content or a feature of the website and did not receive a satisfactory answer, you can refer the matter to the Défenseur des droits (the French rights ombudsman):
remedies.message: Send a message to the Défenseur des droits (in French)
remedies.delegate: Contact a local delegate of the Défenseur des droits (in French)
remedies.post: Send a letter by post (free of charge, no stamp needed):
remedies.address: Défenseur des droits, Libre réponse 71120, 75342 Paris CEDEX 07, France

declaration.date: Provisional statement drawn up on 21 November 2026.
